 Summary
 Kluivert and Tavernier penalties put Bournemouth ahead against AC Milan as Maignan sent off

 Post published at 21:35 BST 21:35 BST 
 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 We're closing in on the final 15 minutes here. 
 AC Milan's only shot was in the first minute of the game and they've not had a shot on target.
 They've been rubbish.

 Besiktas 1-2 Crystal Palace 
 Crystal Palace make a change as Yeremy Pino, who got the equaliser, is replaced by Darío Osorio.

 Is it just me, or is it just brilliant seeing clubs like Sunderland, Palace, Bournemouth + Brighton in Europe...very fresh vibe here.

 Palace 'tiring' published at 21:33 BST 21:33 BST 
 Besiktas 1-2 Crystal Palace 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 A few unforced errors creeping into that Palace midfield. They are just tiring.
 19 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:32 BST 21:32 BST 
 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 Bournemouth are showboating now.
 Alvaro Rodríguez does an outrageous flick to send in Adrien Truffert before Ryan Christie slices wide. 
 74 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:31 BST 21:31 BST 
 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 It is just wave after wave of Bournemouth attack at the moment.
 Rayan headed over the bar a minute or two ago and now he's just been fed in down the right and seen his cross blocked. 
 113 3 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:31 BST 21:31 BST 
 Besiktas 1-2 Crystal Palace 
 Just over 20 minutes to go - a big 20 minutes for Crystal Palace because if they can hold firm this will be a big win for them, both in terms of result and what it could do to their confidence.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 153 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:30 BST 21:30 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 RE: Jon.
Not feeling foolish at all. We've been terrible all season. Can't convert chances and always wide open at the back. The Brighton result had been coming since game 1. I know we've been spoilt the last few years but if Sage stays we will get relegated.
 Jay 
 29 173 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Celtic trailing published at 21:29 BST 21:29 BST 
 Well, we've just told you that Celtic had been pegged back.
 They are now losing to Celta Vigo and are heading for their third successive Europa League defeat. 
 Follow Celtic v Celta Vigo live. 
 63 21 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTIONS published at 21:29 BST 21:29 BST 
 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 Changes for both sides.
 Alvaro Rodríguez replaces Evanilson for the hosts, while Fikayo Tomori makes way for Sankhoun Diawara. 
 30 4 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:28 BST 21:28 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 I feel bad because I really do like Strand Larsen but Mateta is just miles better.
He just has that ‘boom’ effect…
 Ronnen 
 Image source, Getty Images 
 146 11 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Celtic pegged back published at 21:28 BST 21:28 BST 
 Celta Vigo have equalised against Celtic at Celtic Park. Javi Rodríguez has powered home a header from a free-kick.
 Celtic have lost their opening two games, don't forget, so a win feels pretty needed here. 
 Follow that one live. 
 43 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'He's got to play the advantage!' published at 21:27 BST 21:27 BST 
 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 Robbie Savage 
Peterborough manager and former Wales midfielder on TNT Sports 
 I think it was a good tackle - don't think it was a foul or a yellow card. If he's given it, he should play the advantage. He's got to play the advantage!
 39 9 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 21:26 BST 21:26 BST 
 Besiktas 1-2 Crystal Palace 
 The hosts also make a double change as Kartal Yılmaz and Taylan Bulut are replaced by Junior Olaitan and Amir Murillo.
 14 8 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 21:26 BST 21:26 BST 
 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 Bournemouth aren't happy. 
 Evanilson catches Fikayo Tomori in possession, and the England defender then brings him down. He wins a good chunk of the ball first, mind.
 Lewis Cook is played through on goal by Alex Toth picking up the loose ball but the referee has already blown his whistle for the foul. Got to play advantage there! 
 43 17 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Both of them have been brilliant' published at 21:24 BST 21:24 BST 
 Besiktas 1-2 Crystal Palace 
 Glenn Hoddle 
Former England and Tottenham manager on TNT Sports 
 You could see that both McNeil and Jean-Philippe Mateta were working so hard. Both of them have been brilliant, and in the 60 minutes have done a fantastic job. Now, it's up to the subs to come on and continue the performance.
 188 7 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:24 BST 21:24 BST 
 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 Rayan has scored in Bournemouth's opening two Europa League games.
 You'd expect him to have some chances to make that three in three against the tired legs of 10-man AC Milan too. 
 53 5 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:24 BST 21:24 BST 
 Click 'Get Involved' at the top of this page to have your say 
 The difference between Mateta and Strand Larsen is night and day.
 Stef 
 123 27 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing

 Bournemouth 2-0 AC Milan 
 Triple change for Bournemouth as we hit the hour mark.
 On: Lewis Cook, Rayan, Alex Toth
 Off: Tyler Adams, Marcus Tavernier, Justin Kluivert
